narrative.overview: Scope: pieces/019-city-of-signs/ only. Procedural black-and-white architecture with whole-tower straight, terraced, and curved profiles; contents fit through contentBox. The approved AI image remains a visual reference. thumbnail.jpg derives from the renderer screenshot 06-square.png, seed 1907, in .impeccable/review/city-six-rounds/2026-09-16/. The user rejected the earlier review approval. Fresh review of the six-round result returned Ship conditional on stale documentation being updated; evidence covers six source/render pairs and final square, mobile, screenshot-proportion, alternate-seed, and catalog views. The result is materially richer but remains more columnar and repetitive than the dream reference, with some bridge overlaps less defined on black facades. These limitations remain at the user’s six-round stopping point; this is not user acceptance.
keyCharacteristics: 32 blocks: 6 ground-only bases, 15 chambers, 8 crowns, 3 connectors
5–20 unequal bays using round(width / height × 9), recomposed for the viewport
Whole-tower profiles and fitted contents; compact seven-blade fan on a straight tower
Balanced crown usage and arched skybridges, crossing stairs, hanging crescents
Immediate regeneration through click, tap, Enter, or Space
No text or pictorial illustrations in the normal canvas

rules.name: Cutout depth
rules.body: Use overlap, apertures, polarity, and scale without shadows or gradients.

dos: Do preserve ground-only bases and viewport-specific composition.
Do keep block drawing functions reusable across dimensions and polarity.
Do capture shipping thumbnails from the renderer with recorded seed and framing.
donts: Don't add room frames, uniform rounded geometry, or a gray drawing palette.
Don't substitute the approved reference raster for procedural geometry.
Don't impose this artwork's design system on other HyperGal pieces.
